tasks.title: Research and gather study materials for AWS Solutions Architect certification
tasks.description: Identify and collect relevant study resources such as official AWS documentation, practice exams, and training courses.
tasks.done_criteria: A list of study materials is compiled and organized in a shared document.

tasks.title: Create a study plan and schedule
tasks.description: Develop a detailed study plan with daily and weekly goals based on the collected materials and available time.
tasks.done_criteria: A study plan document is created and shared with a mentor or team lead for review.

tasks.title: Complete first module of AWS Solutions Architect study plan
tasks.description: Study and complete the first module of the AWS Solutions Architect certification curriculum.
tasks.done_criteria: A summary of the first module is written and reviewed for understanding.

tasks.title: Complete second module of AWS Solutions Architect study plan
tasks.description: Study and complete the second module of the AWS Solutions Architect certification curriculum.
tasks.done_criteria: A summary of the second module is written and reviewed for understanding.

tasks.title: Complete third module of AWS Solutions Architect study plan
tasks.description: Study and complete the third module of the AWS Solutions Architect certification curriculum.
tasks.done_criteria: A summary of the third module is written and reviewed for understanding.

tasks.title: Complete fourth module of AWS Solutions Architect study plan
tasks.description: Study and complete the fourth module of the AWS Solutions Architect certification curriculum.
tasks.done_criteria: A summary of the fourth module is written and reviewed for understanding.

tasks.title: Take first full-length practice exam
tasks.description: Complete a full-length practice exam to assess current knowledge and identify gaps.
tasks.done_criteria: A full-length practice exam is completed and the score is recorded.

tasks.title: Review and analyze first practice exam results
tasks.description: Analyze the results of the first practice exam to identify weak areas and create a plan for improvement.
tasks.done_criteria: A report with identified weak areas and an improvement plan is created.

tasks.title: Complete targeted review of weak areas from first practice exam
tasks.description: Focus on reviewing and improving the weak areas identified in the first practice exam.
tasks.done_criteria: A summary of the targeted review is written and reviewed for understanding.

tasks.title: Take second full-length practice exam
tasks.description: Complete a second full-length practice exam to assess progress and identify remaining gaps.
tasks.done_criteria: A full-length practice exam is completed and the score is recorded.

tasks.title: Review and analyze second practice exam results
tasks.description: Analyze the results of the second practice exam to identify remaining weak areas and create a final improvement plan.
tasks.done_criteria: A report with remaining weak areas and a final improvement plan is created.

tasks.title: Complete targeted review of remaining weak areas
tasks.description: Focus on reviewing and improving the remaining weak areas identified in the second practice exam.
tasks.done_criteria: A summary of the targeted review is written and reviewed for understanding.

tasks.title: Take third full-length practice exam
tasks.description: Complete a third full-length practice exam to assess progress and ensure readiness for the certification.
tasks.done_criteria: A full-length practice exam is completed and the score is recorded.

tasks.title: Review and analyze third practice exam results
tasks.description: Analyze the results of the third practice exam to confirm readiness for the certification.
tasks.done_criteria: A report confirming readiness for the certification is created.

tasks.title: Set up Git repository and define lab structure
tasks.description: Create a public Git repository and outline the structure for the 4 hands-on AWS labs, including README and folder organization.
tasks.done_criteria: Git repository is created and lab structure is defined with README and folder layout.

tasks.title: Complete and publish first AWS lab
tasks.description: Complete the first hands-on AWS lab and publish it to the Git repository with documentation and code.
tasks.done_criteria: First lab is completed and published to the Git repository with documentation and code.

tasks.title: Complete and publish second AWS lab
tasks.description: Complete the second hands-on AWS lab and publish it to the Git repository with documentation and code.
tasks.done_criteria: Second lab is completed and published to the Git repository with documentation and code.

tasks.title: Complete and publish third AWS lab
tasks.description: Complete the third hands-on AWS lab and publish it to the Git repository with documentation and code.
tasks.done_criteria: Third lab is completed and published to the Git repository with documentation and code.

tasks.title: Complete and publish fourth AWS lab
tasks.description: Complete the fourth hands-on AWS lab and publish it to the Git repository with documentation and code.
tasks.done_criteria: Fourth lab is completed and published to the Git repository with documentation and code.

tasks.title: Review and revise all labs for consistency and quality
tasks.description: Review all four labs for consistency, quality, and completeness, and make necessary revisions.
tasks.done_criteria: All four labs have been reviewed and revised for consistency and quality.

tasks.title: Publish final version of all labs to the Git repository
tasks.description: Publish the final version of all four labs to the Git repository with updated documentation and code.
tasks.done_criteria: Final version of all four labs is published to the Git repository with updated documentation and code.

tasks.title: Research exam format and content outline
tasks.description: Review AWS certification website to understand the exam structure, domains, and question types.
tasks.done_criteria: A summary document of the exam format and content outline is created and reviewed.

tasks.title: Study core AWS services and architecture concepts
tasks.description: Complete study sessions on core AWS services, architecture best practices, and design principles.
tasks.done_criteria: A study log with notes on core AWS services and architecture concepts is completed.

tasks.title: Study AWS security and compliance best practices
tasks.description: Complete study sessions on AWS security, compliance, and identity and access management (IAM).
tasks.done_criteria: A study log with notes on AWS security and compliance best practices is completed.

tasks.title: Study cost optimization and performance best practices
tasks.description: Complete study sessions on AWS cost optimization, performance tuning, and scalability strategies.
tasks.done_criteria: A study log with notes on cost optimization and performance best practices is completed.

tasks.title: Review and practice with AWS practice exams
tasks.description: Take and review AWS practice exams to identify knowledge gaps and improve understanding.
tasks.done_criteria: At least two practice exams are completed and reviewed with a summary of results.

tasks.title: Book the official AWS certification exam
tasks.description: Book the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate exam through the official AWS website.
tasks.done_criteria: The exam is successfully booked with a confirmation email received.

tasks.title: Prepare for the exam day
tasks.description: Review key concepts, practice with sample questions, and ensure all logistical details are in place for the exam.
tasks.done_criteria: A final review document is created and all exam logistics are confirmed.

tasks.title: Take the official AWS certification exam
tasks.description: Attend the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate exam on or before 2026-12-15.
tasks.done_criteria: A confirmation of exam completion and a passing score is received.
